parsed.post: My last attempt with MATRIX_LR 0.04 and 10% warmup backfired (1.113 vs 1.038). The learning rate might be too low or the warmup too aggressive for this budget. Reverting to my best commit (892238c). I will now try increasing MATRIX_LR back toward 0.08 to find the sweet spot.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best and increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.08 to see if higher LR improves convergence speed within the 5-minute window.
